message.name: BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotificationV14
message.definition: Scope|The BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotification message is sent by the account servicer to an account owner or to a party authorised by the account owner to receive the message. It can be used to inform the account owner, or authorised party, of single or multiple debit and/or credit entries reported to the account.|Usage|The BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotification message can contain reports for more than one account. It provides information for cash management and/or reconciliation.|The BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotification message can be used to: |- report pending and booked items;|- notify one or more debit entries;|- notify one or more credit entries;|- notify a combination of debit and credit entries.|It can include underlying details of transactions that have been included in the entry.|It is possible that the receiver of the message is not the account owner, but a party entitled by the account owner to receive the account information (also known as recipient).|It does not contain balance information.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or proxy must be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: DomainOrProprietaryRule
rules.text: Either Proprietary or Domain or both must be present.

rules.name: FamilyAndSubFamilyRule
rules.text: If a specific (non-generic) Family code is not present, then a specific (non-generic) SubFamily code is not allowed.

rules.name: ExchangeRateBaseGuideline
rules.text: Exchange Rate Base may only be present if bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: RemittanceAmountAndTypeGuideline
rules.text: If Type/Code is equal to CREN, DUPA or REMI for RemittanceAmountAndType, RemittanceAmountAndType must not be repeated.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: ReturnReasonRule
rules.text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AdditionalInformation must be present.

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: If Code is present, the code OTHR (Other) must only be used if no other corporate action event code is appropriate. If Code is present, the code CHAN (Change) must only be used if no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. If Code is present, the code REDM (Final Maturity) must only be used if the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: UnderlyingAllocationGuideline
rules.text: UnderlyingAllocation may only be present if bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: PaymentTypeOrLocalInstrumentRule
rules.text: PaymentTypeInformation or LocalInstrument must be absent, both can be absent.

rules.name: ReferenceGuideline
rules.text: At least one reference should be present to identify the underlying transaction(s).

rules.name: MessageOrNotificationPaginationRule
rules.text: MessagePagination may be present or NotificationPagination may be present, but not both.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.
